dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: (Aaagh! My beak... won't move... at all! Ow, ow, ow...)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Your beak's been injured. Give me a moment, I'll take care of it...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Fortunately, it was just the tip... What did you peck at, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: (Over there, among the soft flowers, there's some tough, pretty ones too! I wanted to pick one and bring it home!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: At the Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse, you mean? I believe that a portion of the flowers they sell are made of metal... I see. No wonder.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Alright, child. Don't just peck at anything you see. I'll purchase one for you. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: (Thanks! The flower, so pretty! I'll bring it home, and home will be pretty too!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Here you go. Is it heavy? Will you need help bringing it back?

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: (I can move it. Pretty flower, thank you! I'm off! I'm off!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Slow down, and make sure to hold it tight, or it might fall halfway...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Finch takes flight before Lauma can finish, the flower grasped in its talons. She watches worriedly as it sways this way and that all the way home.

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: Aaagh! My beak... won't move... at all! Ow, ow, ow...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hey, keep still. You hurt your beak, and it'll only hurt more if you keep moving.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Alright, looks like it was just the tip... Did you bump your beak into something or what?

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: It happened over there. Among the soft flowers, there's some tough, pretty ones too! I wanted to pick one and bring it home!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: At the Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse, you mean? Lauma mentioned this before... The flowers they sell there are all made of metal...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You want a flower from there, you say? I'll go get one for you.

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: Thanks! The flower, so pretty! I'll bring it home, and home will be pretty too!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Here, I got you your flower.

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: Pretty flower, thank you! I'm off! I'm off!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Are you sure you're able to hold on to it? What if the metal flower falls out from your beak while you're flying up there...?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...Oh, it's already gone. May they both find their way home safely.
